N. A full-time employee who is reduced to part-time because of a reduction in hours by the Employer works hours by the Employer shall retain his full-time seniority for (2) two years after being reduced to part-time.

Q. A full-time employee who is reduced to part-time with the approval of the Employer at the employee's written request shall lose their full-time seniority; however they shall have preference over a new employee for a full-time job their preference in their store only.

P. When a Journeyman is promoted to Head Meat Cutter, he shall retain seniority in the Journeyman's classification.

Q. In the event of store closing, the Head Meat Cutter in each store shall retain seniority in the Journeyman classification. Service in the Head Meat Cutter classification immediately prior to his most recent appointment as a Head Meat Cutter shall be credited to his Journeyman classification seniority. In case a Head Meat Cutter is transferred to another store or is promoted to a higher classification or is transferred to another store as Head Meat Cutter, the displaced Head Meat Cutter shall retain seniority as a Journeyman, including his service in his most recent appointment as a Head Meat Cutter.

R. In the event the Employer closes or sells a store, the employees two (2) or more with the most seniority may displace the least senior employee in their classification (Head Meat Cutter considered Junior most Journeyman Meat Cutter) within the jurisdiction of Local No. 400. No employees thus displaced shall have any recourse against the Employer or the Union.

S. When two or more full-time employees are hired into the same job classification on the same date in the same seniority area, the Employer shall, at such time as it becomes date material, advertise the Union of their seniority status.

T. Transfers of full-time employees are permitted between markets of the Employer in the seniority area or zone, provided seniority is transferred. Transfers shall be based on legitimate business needs. Seniority for all transfers shall be based on seniority in the area and zone, except for vacation relief, or illness, or store closure. Unless otherwise agreed to in writing in special cases by the Employer and the Union. Employees transferred for vacation relief or to act as me relief because of illness shall be returned to the store from which he was transferred immediately upon the return of the employee on vacation relief or because of illness, seniority in the market will be followed.

U. When a full-time employee is transferred into another seniority area at his request, such employee shall be placed at the bottom of the seniority list if he is a new employee in that classification, or shall lose his seniority if he is transferred. When a full-time employee is transferred into another seniority area at the Employer's request, such employee's seniority in the seniority area into which such employee has been transferred shall include his seniority prior to the transfer.

V. A Head Meat Cutter who is demoted to Journeyman for any reason whatsoever, shall have his continuous service credits transferred to the Journeyman seniority group.

W. Part-time employees shall be given the first opportunity for permanent full-time jobs in their classification based on seniority in their respective stores before new employees are hired for such full-time jobs.

Where no part-time employee within a store desires full-time work, employees working less than forty (40) hours in the area and who have previously indicated in writing to the Employer their desire for full-time work, shall be given the first opportunity for full-time work based upon seniority within the area.

The Employer will schedule all work for part-time employees based on seniority within their classification within their store not to exceed eight (8) hours in any one (1) day or forty (40) hours in any one (1) week, provided the employee is qualified and available for at least four (4) consecutive hours when the work is available and that this scheduling does not conflict with or prohibit the scheduling of a full-time employee in that classification in that store. However, this scheduling is not intended to mean that the Employer must schedule so as to incur additional premiums or penalties or violate any provisions of the Agreement. The part-time employee who desires full-time work shall notify the Store Manager that he is available for a posted schedule within twenty-four (24) hours after the posted schedule is set and provide he has no claim on his schedule of hours cutting.

Part-time employees by classification with the most seniority within a store will be given the part-time schedule with the most hours, provided they are qualified to perform the work required and are immediately available.

X. During the term of this Agreement, the Employer will not reduce the scheduled hours of its regular full-time employees on the payroll as of November 15, 1975, unless a layoff occurs or a reduction has occurred in accordance with the parties' side letter regarding the proper interpretation of Section N of Article 10 Seniority), until the following:

(1) All part-time employees by classification who were on the payroll April 15, 1975, and not covered by Health and Welfare and Pension are laid off in that store.

(2) All part-time employees by classification who are covered by Health and Welfare and Pension (twenty-four (24) hours or more) on the effective date of this Agreement are reduced by seniority to a schedule of two-twenty four (24) hours or more.

(3) All part-time employees by classification as outlined in (2) above are reduced to lavous status in that store.

(4) Notwithstanding the provisions above, the Employer will assign work on seniority basis to a full-time employee in more than one store in an area to maintain his or her forty (40) hour schedule. If said employee refuses said assignment, he or she forfeits their claim to the scheduled hours.

Y. Definition of a full-time employee: All employees on the full-time seniority list as of April 15, 1975, and not covered by Health and Welfare who darts forty (40) hours per week for six (6) weeks during an eight-week period shall be considered as working full-time (40 hours) due to the absence of another full-time employee.

When an employee qualifies as outlined above, their full-time seniority date shall be the date of the beginning of the qualification period.

Z. When a full-time employee in the Journeyman or Weighers and Wrappers classifications desires to move to another store in his or her seniority area, the employee will give notification, in writing, to an official designated by the Store Manager, the Personnel Manager and the Union, stating the store or stores he desires to move. When there is a bona fide vacancy in his or her classification in such store, the employee's request for transfer will be considered based on seniority and ability to perform the work.

Z-1. Department seniority for a separate classification with separate seniority. In the event of a layoff, Meat Cutters (Journeymen) on payroll as of ratification) may apply their seniority into the Seafood Department in lieu of being laid off, at their current rate of pay, on the therefore Seafood Department Clerk rate whichever is less. Present Seafood Department employees, upon notice of layoff, may apply their seniority in order to bump into the Meat Department. If they decide to stay in the Seafood Department they will remain in the Seafood Department only then apply to the Seafood Department only in the event of layoff or of layoffs (this applies only to those Seafood Department employees who were on the payroll as of ratification) may exercise their seniority into the Meat Department.

Seafood Clerks hired after ratification of this agreement shall have seniority in the Seafood Department only. Should a Seafood Clerk desire promotion to a higher classification, such Clerk shall make their wishes known to their Zone Manager in writing with copies to the Personnel Manager and the Union. Such Seafood Clerk will be considered by seniority from those who have made their wishes known in writing.
